title: Acting Combat
paragraphs: “Oh, don’t think we’ll run out of eggs, okay?”
As Trash muttered this, the pigs brought out more of Filolial-sama’s eggs, as if to say there were still plenty left.
“Even if they’re lined up like we bought a huge batch of those 100-yen-per-pack eggs from the supermarket…”
“I suppose this is the reason why Filolial eggs are running out all over the world. They’re a terrifying bunch to go this far.”
“What a hideous strategy.”
“Since Motoyasu-kun is the one who can keep this under control, there’s no doubt it’s… the right approach.”
You pigs and Trash! You’re wasting your brains on this! No matter what happens, I will absolutely not forgive them!
“Well then… Spear Hero! Kill the Shield! Otherwise, we’ll just keep destroying these eggs! Seeing you suffer is our greatest joy!”
Ugh… If I don’t fight Father, they’ll destroy the new Filolial-sama eggs. But attacking Father goes against my sense of loyalty. It’s not as if one of us is superior or has priority over the other.
It’s such a difficult dilemma that smoke is practically coming out of my head. But if I hesitate here and fail to act, more of Filolial-sama’s eggs will be destroyed!
Just as I was wavering, Father began speaking softly, in a whisper.
“Don’t move. Motoyasu, keep up the act that you’re injured.”
W-what is this? No, since he’s saying this, Father must surely have a brilliant plan. I’m standing here frozen solid, just as he told me to.
“Something’s off… Aultcray hasn’t been looking our way for a while now. His words are extreme, but he’s just pretending to watch us—his gaze is actually fixed on something else entirely.”
Is that so? Now that you mention it, his movements have been strangely sluggish. I thought he wanted to take his time watching me suffer, but perhaps that’s not the case?

“Maybe he’s trying to tell us something… But since he’s known as the Wise King of Wisdom, this could be a trap. Still… we want to buy time just as much as he does. Sorry, Motoyasu, but you’ll have to play along.”
Father gave me a slight smile.
“It’s okay. I’m not weak enough to be easily defeated by Motoyasu-kun’s attacks anymore. After all, you’re the one who raised me.”
Those words somehow tugged at my heartstrings, Father! As soon as I said that, Father backed away from me and glared.
“…Hmph. Looks like I’ll have to fight you after all, Motoyasu.”
Father gave me a hostile glare and raised his shield.
“Motoyasu… no, Motoyasu! I know all too well—and I’m sick and tired of it—how addicted you are to Filolial. I won’t let you get killed!”
Speaking in a slightly petty tone, Father deployed his Shooting Star Shield. Ugh… Are you telling me to attack Father right here? But… ugh…
Enduring a stomachache so bad I might cough up blood, I have no choice but to swing my spear at Father while trembling.
“Lord Motoyasu!”
“That’s right!”
“Ah! You lot, fight too! Filolial, the Spear Hero—you must fight as well… You know what will happen if you don’t, don’t you?”
“Ugh… How despicable! To resort to such underhanded and vile tactics—the cruelty of the Wise King of Wisdom and those under Takt’s influence… I absolutely will not forgive this!”
“Say whatever you like! This is our… battle for revenge!”
“Ugh… Lord Motoyasu…”
Just as Yuki-chan transforms into her Filolial form and tries to run toward me, Rival steps in front of her.
“…Yuki! I won’t let you!”
“Please don’t interfere! All of this is… for Lord Motoyasu’s sake.”
“Gaelion will protect Naofumi. I don’t know anything about some ‘Spear Hero.’”
“To fail to understand the pain in Lord Motoyasu’s heart… just as I thought… you really are a dragon, aren’t you?”
“Call me whatever you like. It’s a fact that dragons and Filolials are incompatible!”
Rival takes a fighting stance while still in human form. At this moment, Yuki-chan charges at Rival at high speed, taking the lead, and unleashes a flurry of kicks—but Rival begins to parry them all.
“Bububu!”
“Hurry up and attack! Spear Hero!”
Along with the pig’s voice, Trash ordered me to attack while smashing a single egg down loudly.
Guuuuuuuuuuu… First, I must make Rival pay! …Otherwise, I won’t be able to hold myself back.
“Die! Rival!”
This is actually a bit easier than fighting Father!
“Whoa, don’t think the Shield Hero can’t attack!”
Saying that, Father switched to a spiked shield that inflicts status ailments and ran toward me as I tried to attack Rival.
I seem to remember seeing this scene before.
First… back when I was foolish, the battle where Big Sister was the stake. He didn’t use a shield, but a balloon—looking back now, that was a truly admirable display of initiative.
Next was the battle during a different playthrough, when Itsuki challenged me to a duel to save Keel… Back then, I’d also subdued Father with status ailments.
“Woooooooooooooooooooooo!”
Father raises his fist high and swings it at me. This is definitely a provocation. I… recall that moment and unleash those Skills.
“Chaos Stab/Chaos Spear!”
The tip of my spear splits into multiple prongs and flies toward Father. He takes every single one of those attacks, and it ends with nothing more than a shower of sparks.
Ah… Father. As expected of you. You’re incredibly tough.
Now Father raises his shield and uses the reflection of the spikes to stab at me. Normally, I’d be afflicted with a status ailment here, but since I’ve mastered various skills, I’m able to resist it.
However… I’ll pretend to be affected by a status ailment, place my hand over my face as if I’m dizzy, and shove Father away.
“Ugh…”
“How’s that! This is it! The battle of the Shield Hero!”
I know you’re not fighting in earnest, Father, but it still hurts my heart.
“You’re doing quite well, Father. But if you think you can defeat me with something like this, you’re mistaken!”
“Bububu! Bubuu!”
“What are you slacking off for? Put some more effort into it! Spear Hero!”
Guaaaaaaaaaaaaah! That pig and that Trash have cracked another of Filolial-sama’s eggs! I’ll definitely slaughter them in the most gruesome way possible!
Father shifts his gaze from Trash to the squealing pig. Just as he’s glaring at it, the pig unleashes a massive wing blow right at him.
“Haa!”

Father brushes it off as if it’s no big deal, but in this situation… the wound in my heart is throbbing. It reminds me of back then, when I knew nothing and was being played like a fool by the Crimson Swine… Though the circumstances are different, there are many parallels. Ugh… it feels like my stomach is about to tear open.
“Just come at me already!”
Father taunted me once again. But I… I—!
“…I guess I’ve got no choice.”
With that, Rival formed a magic projectile with one hand and fired it at the pig over by Trash.
“Oink!?”
“Oink!”
“Oink!”
With a “boom,” Rival’s Magic hit the pig; the other pigs managed to mitigate the damage, but it was left in tatters. But at the same time, countless of Filolial-sama’s eggs were shattered!
Rival, you bastard! What on earth are you doing here?!
“Youuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu!”

I’ll prioritize wiping Rival off the face of the earth before fighting Father! But if I unleash Brionac at full power, stray shots will hit the others. So, I’ll focus on a single target! This is a sure-hit attack!
“Die! Gungnir X!”
I unleashed Gungnir, my guaranteed-hit skill, straight at Rival.
“Haa!”
Father stepped in and deflected the Gungnir—which I’d aimed right between Rival’s eyebrows—with his shield. What!?　Father! Why are you protecting Rival!?
“Is that all you’ve got? That’s not even a contest!”
“Father! Rival… no, that dragon has committed an unforgivable sin.”
“…I don’t know about that. Gaelion-chan must have chosen me over Motoyasu-kun and Filolial, after all.”

Ugh… Those are such cold, dismissive words from Father. Does he care that much about Rival!? That guy is a dragon—he’s my enemy! With an attitude like this, Filo-tan and Sakura-chan will be heartbroken!
…No, my faith in Father is whispering to me. That he’s deliberately protecting Rival. That he’s making me angry to minimize the damage—so that Filolial-sama’s egg won’t be broken because of me.
I do have faith in him. But I’m also angry. That’s exactly why I can’t show any mercy!
“If you get in my way, I won’t hold back!”
With a twinge of stomach pain, I launched a thrust toward Father.
“Hah! This is—”
Father, anticipating what would come next after my thrust, deflected the tip of my spear with his shield.
“Burst Lance X!”
With a loud bang, the tip of my spear exploded with extraordinary force.
“Whoa… Drifa Heal V!”
Even Father, impressive as he is, took a hit from my Burst Lance attack and was wounded, but he immediately healed his injury with Magic.
“And now… Windmill!”
In tornado mode, I unleashed the Windmill at Father and took my time charging the Brionac.
“Don’t get in my way!”
“I won’t let you!”
Rival and Yuki-chan are locked in a grapple, but right now we should focus our attacks on Father.
“Boo-boo-boo-boo!”

I could hear the pig cackling from behind as Father and I fought. You lot, I’ll definitely remember this! The attack itself packs quite a punch, but I’ll unleash it without putting any real power behind it. That way, I should be able to pull it off just by the way it looks!
“Turn into a pile of charcoal with this! Brionac X!”
I fired my very first Brionac aimed at Father, as if I were praying.
“Air Strike Shield V! Second Shield V! Shield Prison V! Shooting Star Shield X!”

With loud clangs, Father took my attacks head-on. In this world, Father usually deflects attacks with moves like Air One-Way Shield, but this time, he’s taking them head-on to keep the Brionac’s trajectory from veering off course. What’s more, he’s adjusting his Defense Power to make it look like the skill shields that appear are getting shattered one after another. Ugh… Even from a vantage point like this, I can really feel Father’s compassion and acting skills.
“Woooooooooooooo!”

Screaming, I keep attacking Father without putting any real power behind my strikes. I destroy the shields that Father summons one by one… After breaking the Shooting Star Shield barrier, the shield cage shatters, and just as I’ve penetrated it slightly, I run out of ammo and catch my breath, panting heavily.
“Haa… haa… He’s so tough.”
“That’s… exactly what I was going to say.”
Guh… I must have gone too hard—Father looks like he’s injured. How should I fight from here on out?
“Hate Reaction! Come on, come at me!”
Father cast a skill that draws enemy aggro right at me. Guh… For some reason, I just can’t stop focusing on Father.
“Bububu!”
Now those pigs are even launching attack Magic and sniper fire at us! Just how far do they plan to take this?
“Guh…”
“I’m not just going to stand by and watch!”
I used my cloak to deflect the incoming spells, and Father also took a defensive stance.
“Naofumi!?”
“Motoyasu-sama!”

As if to follow up on the attack, a magic circle was drawn on the ground, and Ceremonial Magic—the advanced group synthesis magic ‘Last Judgment’—rained down, engulfing both me and Father. Since it was Magic cast by those pigs from Takt, I’d say it had quite a bit of power, wouldn’t you agree?
“Oink, oink, oink!”
Their cackling makes me want to vomit, but smoke is rising. Now then… time to check on Father. Judging by his aura, he’s still in one piece. He hasn’t taken that much damage either.
Just as I was thinking that, a loud thud echoed from the distance!
This must be—! It seems that while we were buying time, Zou and Kou must have discovered something. They’ve apparently cleared a wide escape route.
“Oink!? Oo-oo-oo!”
“W-who are you! To dare interrupt our entertainment!”
The Trash and the pig are yelling toward the sound, clearly seething with rage. Soon, from a spot slightly off to the side of where the sound came from… the door to the room was smashed open.
“Oink!?”
“Who’s that!?”
“Huh? Shield Heroes and Spear Heroes, how’s it going?”
At that moment, Panda called out to us. Wait a minute—weren’t you supposed to have gone with Sakura-chan to rescue your Finacée?
“Naofumi! Are you okay?”
It looks like Sakura-chan is here, too. Just then, the dust cloud cleared. I turned my gaze toward Panda, Sakura-chan, and the others.
There, Panda, Éclair, and Sakura-chan were standing with the Queen, her Finacée, and the Tiger Guys.
